reviews.title: The most incredible birth companion
reviews.contents: I gave birth to my beautiful baby girl two weeks ago and had a really wonderful and empowering birth. I did heaps of practice with the app and on the day I spent my whole labor listening to the hypnosis. I found this a great companion to my hypnobirthing classes. One of the craziest experiences of the day was listening to the 30 minute birth rehearsal while labouring and thinking we didn’t start it right because it felt like it only went for three minutes. I must have fallen asleep or into deep relaxation mid labor! I remained super calm for my whole birth and baby was born three hours after getting to hospital. The midwives told me they loved being present at my birth because it was so calm and strong. Thank you so much you really helped me have a wonderful birthing experience.

reviews.title: I was confident and positive throughout the entire birth
reviews.contents: The birth of my first child was the most positive and powerful experience I’ve ever had. It sounds crazy but I enjoyed experiencing the entire process. I felt optimistic, strong, in control and had full trust in my body. I think this is largely thanks to using this app daily throughout the third trimester. I was falling asleep to the hypnobirthing recordings, listening to affirmations on my way to work and meditating after work. Today I found out that I’m expecting again and the first thing that popped into my mind was to re-download the app. Thanks guys, looking forward to a second pregnancy journey with you.

reviews.title: Worthwhile even at the last minute
reviews.contents: I didn’t hear about the app until I was a few weeks off my due date but I downloaded it anyway and listened to at least one session a day whenever I could fit it in, especially the night time Hypnobirthing sessions. Couldn’t recommend highly enough. I was able to get through my second baby’s delivery without pain-relief thanks to practicing the breathing techniques and having visualized a positive experience.

reviews.title: Amazing resource - highly recommend
reviews.contents: The meditative state that can be achieved by listening to the recordings along with the helpful knowledge and information that comes with it is fantastic. You can really feel the value in bringing yourself into a relaxed state. So worth it. Looking forward to having this as my companion during labour.

reviews.title: Better every day
reviews.contents: So comprehensive, with journeys that adapts to our needs in the moment, beyond pregnancy! I’m so glad that I came across with this app during my latest pregnancy because it changed my experience and my life forever.

reviews.title: Wish I found it sooner!
reviews.contents: This app has easy to follow and find resources to help ease the mind and take a lot of the stress out of the unknown for a first time expectant mum.

reviews.title: Beautiful and personal
reviews.contents: A beautiful and personal, private companion as I drift off to sleep each night and dream about meeting my baby ✨ Love the app and the meditations. So thankful x

reviews.title: Highly recommend
reviews.contents: Love the support, resources and how easy it is to practice. Helping me a lot mentally through pregnancy so far

reviews.title: Very helpful
reviews.contents: Very helpful to relax and calm yourself during pregnancy. Great reminders throughout pregnancy and looking forward to using it during labor

reviews.title: Most practical app
reviews.contents: Love using this daily. Gives me so much peace throughout this journey.
